name: How long does a typical kitchen peninsula installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen peninsula installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen peninsula installation depends on the project's scope, including whether it involves structural changes, new utility lines, or custom fabrication. A straightforward installation without major utility work might take a few days, while more complex projects requiring plumbing, electrical, or significant structural adjustments can extend to a week or more. We aim to provide clear timelines after an initial assessment, helping you plan around the construction process efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Peninsula installation time varies by scope; simple projects might take days, complex ones with utility work can take a week or more.
